description: The Department of Veterans Affairs - Network Contracting Office 17 is seeking to procure to purchase Medivator EndoDry, Cabinet, 8 shelves, with an authorized vendor to supply and deliver the item(s). This equipment is intended for use by the VA Valley Coastal Bend Harlingen Care Center, Station 740 (VATVCB HCC), located in Harlingen, Texas.
